Short title and Commencement

HAZARA FOREST (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
HAZARA FOREST (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1997
An Act further to amend the
Hazara Forest Act, 1936
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 17th July, 1997]
PA/NWFP/Legis/97/14908, dated 17‑7‑1997.‑‑The
Hazara Forest (Amendment) Bill, 1997, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the North‑West Frontier Province on the 8th July, 1997 and
assented to by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province on the
12th July, 1997 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
North‑West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Hazara
Forest (Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 7th January, 1997..

Amendment of section 3 of N.-W.F.P. Act III of 1937

HAZARA FOREST (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
HAZARA FOREST (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1997
An Act further to amend the
Hazara Forest Act, 1936
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 17th July, 1997]
PA/NWFP/Legis/97/14908, dated 17‑7‑1997.‑‑The
Hazara Forest (Amendment) Bill, 1997, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the North‑West Frontier Province on the 8th July, 1997 and
assented to by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province on the
12th July, 1997 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
North‑West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 3 of
N.‑W.F.P: Act III of 1937.‑‑‑In the Hazara Forest
Act, 1936 (N.‑W.F.P. Act III of 1937), hereinafter referred to as the
said Act, the existing section 3 shall be renumbered as subsection (1) of
section 3 and after subsection (1), as so renumbered, the following new
subsection (2) shall be inserted, namely:
"(2)
Notwithstanding the provisions of subsection (1), Government may, where it
considers appropriate, manage the forests with the help and active
participation of village community on such terms and conditions as may be
prescribed.".

Amendment of section 53 of N.-W.F.P. Act III of 1937

1997

[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,

PA/NWFP/Legis/97/14908, dated 17‑7‑1997.‑‑The
Hazara Forest (Amendment) Bill, 1997, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the North‑West Frontier Province on the 8th July, 1997 and
assented to by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province on the
12th July, 1997 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
North‑West Frontier Province.
3. Amendment of section 53 of
N.‑W.F.P. Act III of 1937.‑‑In the said Act, in section
53, in subsection (2), the full‑stop appearing at the end of clause (c)
shall be replaced by a semi‑colon and thereafter the following new clause
shall be added, namely:
"(d)
provide for the management of reserved forests through participation of village
community.".
